raw_text:
Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - User Profile Enumeration

IDOR vulnerability in /api/v2/profile/{user_id} endpoint.
User profiles can be accessed by manipulating numeric user ID parameter.
No authorization checks performed to verify access rights.

Attack vector: Sequential ID enumeration from 1-1000 reveals all user records.

Exposed data includes:
- User emails: john.doe@acmecorp.com, jane.smith@gmail.com
- Internal contact: admin@internal.staging.local
- AWS key discovered in user profile: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
- JWT tokens from session cookies: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIiwibmFtZSI6IkFkbWluIn0.dozjgNryP4J3jVmNHl0w5N_XgL0n3I9PlFUP0THsR8U
- Internal database host: prod-db.internal
- Testing from IP: 10.50.60.70
- GCP service token: ya29.a0AfH6SMCx_example_serviceaccount
